name: Celare Quantum Communications
description: Celare Quantum Communications (CQC) is a DTU spinout developing the first commercial continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) network appliance in 19-inch rack format. Founded by DTU researcher Tobias Gehring, CQC builds CV-QKD modules designed to integrate with existing telecom infrastructure, providing physically secure key exchange resistant to both current and future quantum attacks. The company is a partner in the DKK 25.9M Innovation Fund Denmark AccessQKD project alongside DTU, Aarhus University, Partisia, and GlobalConnect.

news.title: From Prototype to Product: Celare Quantum's vision for QKD deployment
news.excerpt: Tobias Gehring, CEO of Celare Quantum, discusses the company's transition from laboratory prototypes to commercial quantum key distribution products, highlighting growing demand from critical sectors including government, military, telecom, and finance.

news.title: Danish quantum research strengthens its leading position
news.excerpt: Innovation Fund Denmark awards DKK 25.9 million to the AccessQKD project, which will develop scalable, market-ready quantum encryption technology for telecommunications networks. Celare Quantum Communications ApS is listed as a core partner.
